goals.title: Proactively review every ENG deployment before it happens
goals.why: Security reviews after the fact are useless. I need to be in the loop before changes ship.
goals.progress: No formal pre-deploy security review handshake exists yet; ENG changes today were mostly docs/config churn. Need an explicit review request step before any security-relevant deploys.
goals.nextAction: Ask ENG to adopt a pre-deploy checklist: ping INFOSEC with diff/PR + threat notes for any tool/config/integration changes.

goals.title: Build a threat model for the RedOS system
goals.why: We have multiple agents with tool/exec capabilities + Slack/Telegram integrations, and no formal threat model. That is a risk.
goals.progress: Drafted an initial threat model section in workspace/ops/SECURITY-HARDENING.md (prompt injection/tool abuse, credential leakage, cross-agent escalation, SSRF/DNS, exec allowlists).
goals.nextAction: Expand threat model into concrete controls: (1) inbound content handling rules, (2) file write boundaries, (3) A2A comms rules, (4) incident response/rotation triggers.

goals.title: Alert RED immediately when any security concern is found — no delays
goals.why: A security concern that sits in my notes for 24h is a vulnerability window.
goals.progress: Security alerts have been escalated previously (DNS/SSRF resolver issue). Ongoing focus: keep escalations crisp and action-oriented.
goals.nextAction: When a P1/P0 security ticket remains open >2h, post an explicit 'manual actions required' block + closure criteria to mission-control.
